name: DS5Dongle-ESP (ESP-IDF / ESP32-S31)
//image-note: esp32s31 is only in ESP-IDF master (a preview target), so the stock espressif/idf tags do NOT support it. Build a master-based image first: docker build -t espidf:s31 --build-arg IDF_CLONE_BRANCH_OR_TAG=master --build-arg IDF_INSTALL_TARGETS=esp32s31 --build-arg IDF_CLONE_SHALLOW=1 'https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git#master:tools/docker'
